sentences.text: If a conflict can occur, an apologetic message can repair the damage before it can cause permanent detriment, a small obstacle that any strong scholar can surmount.
sentences.translation: 如果冲突可能发生,一封道歉的消息可以在其造成永久损害之前修复伤害——这个小小的障碍,任何坚强的学者都能克服。

sentences.text: In all of this, equity can matter a great deal: credit should fall on every partner, a scholar who may disapprove when credit can go to another should question his own motive, and the refinement of such social habit can prove as valuable as technical mastery.
sentences.translation: 在这一切中,公平至关重要:功劳应落在每一位合作伙伴身上,对功劳归于他人感到不满的学者应当反思自己的动机,而社交习惯的打磨可以证明与技术专长一样有价值。

lessonGrammar.name: far more than 强调超出
lessonGrammar.note: far more than 表示"远不止",强调会议价值超出预期,是书面语中的强调结构。
lessonGrammar.sourceExample: An academic conference can offer far more than a lecture, because it can provide a stage where a scholar may exchange an idea through common vocabulary and natural phrase.
lessonGrammar.sourceExampleCn: 学术会议能提供的远不止一场讲座,因为它能提供一个平台,让学者通过共同的词汇和自然的搭配交流想法。

lessonGrammar.name: Before 引导时间状语从句
lessonGrammar.note: Before you travel 交代动作发生的先后顺序,是口语化中规整的书面表达。
lessonGrammar.sourceExample: Before you travel, you can study the prospectus with care so that you know which session can match your interest, and check whether the programme is provisional or final.
lessonGrammar.sourceExampleCn: 出行之前,你可以仔细研究会议手册,以便了解哪个分会场符合你的兴趣,并确认日程是临时的还是最终的。
